title: Boogie woogie and George Thomas
summary: Brief talk about when boogie woogie began in New Orleans and the number Hopscotch Blues.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did he play what they call Boogie Woogie now?
Yeah, yeah. He played Boogie Woogie now. I think.
When did Boogie Woogie come in? Huh? When did that Boogie Woogie come out? The Boogie Woogie come out. Yeah. Years back. One of the...
I couldn't play piano. Just play out my money. And put a whole lot of stuff in the end and they started calling it a Boogie Woogie. And they picked up from that.
You remember George Thomas, the piano player?
I think he and Clarence Williams were friends. Yeah, I didn't know.
He had a number that came out down here that had some Boogie Woogie in it. The New Orleans Hopscotch Blues. Way back.
